forbidden_uses: choosing a retention level because it passes when the full geometry fails
dropping species, localities, or edges from the formal geometry based on this diagnostic
changing bandwidth, graph density, alpha, Wilson thresholds, reference configurations, or world counts based on this diagnostic
using diagnostic results to authorize Phase-4 nucleotide identity opening
describing a formal Gate-D failure as a biological negative
formal_decision_rule: Only the pre-existing Phase-3 Gate-D result on the exact retention=1.0 Phase-2 survivor geometry controls PASS versus NOT_EVALUABLE. Every thinned result is descriptive sensitivity information only.

planned_synthetic_metrics.purpose: Reserved for a separate diagnostic execution layer that reuses the frozen synthetic Gate-D family without conferring formal decision authority.

purpose: Measure how synthetic Gate-D geometry support changes under deterministic nested locality thinning of the exact fresh phylogatR Phase-2 survivor panel. This diagnostic has no authority to alter, rescue, replace, or reinterpret the formal Phase-3 Gate-D decision.

stress_design.full_geometry_role: retention_fraction=1.0 is the only geometry that may enter the formal Phase-3 Gate-D authorization
stress_design.graph_rule: recompute the same density-scaled undirected kNN graph at neighbor_fraction=0.15 on each thinned counterfactual geometry
stress_design.nestedness: one immutable per-species locality ranking is reused for every retention fraction; each lower-retention selected set must be a subset of every higher-retention selected set
stress_design.selected_output_order: ascending original locality index after hash-ranked selection
stress_design.selection_rank: ascending SHA256(UTF8(dataset_digest_sha256 + '|fragility|v0.1|' + canonical_species_name + '|' + decimal_original_locality_index)); ties impossible except digest collision
